notes: Computer History Museum catalogue 102718654, 'Xbox 360 console', '2005 (Made)', Microsoft Corporation (Manufacturer), category Game Console; the record describes the console itself, no box. The record does not name the SKU; a 2005 build predates the 2010 Xbox 360 S, so it is the original shell.

Axes as CHM labels them: w, h, l; l is recorded as depth. The record prints inches ('11 1/2w x 3 1/4h x 10 1/8l (in)') and its own centimetres; the mm values are the CHM centimetres shifted one decimal (no conversion of ours). CHM's centimetres are themselves rounded from fractional inches, so treat the envelope as about 1/8 in precision.
Mass not filed: CHM gives '6 (lb)', a whole-pound figure.
No Microsoft page with the original 360's dimensions was reachable (archived xbox.com 360 pages fetched had none; Microsoft eco profiles start at the One S).
external_ids: Wikidata Q48263 (Xbox 360, the platform) confirmed through the Wikidata API; igdb_platform 'xbox360' is Wikidata's P5795 on that item.
